# CAD attribution

The ten STL files in `STL/` are third-party mechanical assets. They are not claimed as original CAD designs by Aishik Tokdar.

Source: [Solar Tracker Tilt/Pan Panel Frame LDR Mounts Rig](https://www.instructables.com/SOLAR-TRACKER-TILTPAN-PANEL-FRAME-LDR-MOUNTS-RIG/).

Credit remains with the original designer and the source publication. The pre-restructure README described these assets as shared for non-commercial educational use. That description is retained here as historical information; confirm the source's actual license and redistribution terms before further use or redistribution.

The repository's MIT license does not relicense these STL files. No new CAD authorship or permission is asserted.
